name: toolkit
description: The Toolkit V2 runtime: the toolkit command, the hooks that brief each session and check work items and memory, and the project-setup skill that sets up or repairs a project. Its hooks do nothing outside a Toolkit V2 project.

interface.shortDescription: Set up a project and run the Toolkit V2 command and hooks.
interface.longDescription: The runtime every Toolkit V2 project needs. The project-setup skill asks where to track work, which memory to use, and whether it is a Salesforce project, then copies the model scaffold and applies your answers: the matching parts of AGENTS.md, the rules list, and the settings. The toolkit command keeps work items and memory in order. The hooks give each session a short project briefing, report work items moved by hand, and stop hand edits of generated files. Outside a Toolkit V2 project the hooks do nothing.
defaultPrompt: Update the toolkit in this project
